verdict.rationale: GA4 documents a Data API for programmatic report queries, with filters, pagination, batch pivot reports, funnel and realtime reporting, and client libraries. It also documents a first-party export of all raw events to BigQuery, queryable with SQL, as a daily full export plus continuous export; a community user corroborates the BigQuery hookup. Missing for 10: the Data API returns only aggregated report data, not raw events, so raw event-level access depends on the separate BigQuery product; there is also no hands-on evidence of query limits or quotas.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run analytical queries and pull raw event data back through a documented query/export API

citations.quote: You can use the Data API to programmatically access Google Analytics report data.
You can export all of your raw events from Google Analytics properties ... to BigQuery, and then use an SQL-like syntax to query that data.
A full export of data takes place once a day. Data is also exported continuously throughout the day.
batchRunPivotReports ... Returns multiple pivot reports in a batch.
